text:
simeon-fin: quick heads-up before tonight's price-sheet rollout: ops added a preflight schema enforcement step. ran it against the vendor file and it surfaced one ambiguous column that would've broken grandfathering for a subset.

olivia-ops: what column? can you paste the preflight output?

simeon-fin: snippet from preflight: ```\n2025-10-02T21:02:01Z WARN -> unexpected header 'legacy_flag' (values: 1/0)\n2025-10-02T21:02:01Z INFO -> accepted aliases: preserve_legacy, legacy_preserve, keep_price\n2025-10-02T21:02:01Z WARN -> boolean column 'legacy_flag' uses numeric encoding; parser expects true/false\n2025-10-02T21:02:01Z ACTION -> blocked import until mapping & type rule resolved\n```\n
henry-eng: ah — vendor switched to numeric booleans. that would've been coerced to false by the importer. good catch. I'll add alias 'legacy_flag' and support 1/0 parsing with explicit conversion but only after an explicit mapping entry.

raya-revops: how many rows impacted if we had run?

simeon-fin: preflight says 18 rows in preserve cohorts had non-boolean values for that column. worst-case 12 invoices could have been misbilled.

billing-bot: Preflight alert: import blocked due to unmapped header 'legacy_flag'. Impact estimate: up to 12 invoices in preserved cohorts.

olivia-ops: plan: add alias + conversion rule in staging, run staged import -> dry-run -> then promote. I'll schedule now. ETA 40m.

henry-eng: I'll open a tiny PR that adds: (1) alias 'legacy_flag' -> preserve_legacy, (2) strict type coercion with explicit conversion mapping ("1"/"0" -> true/false), (3) add a failing CI test for vendor schema drift. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/514

raya-revops: also add a short rollback gate: if preflight estimates > 5 impacted invoices, require manual signoff from finance + legal. That would've helped here.

jules-legal: agreed. add wording in the gate: any automatic credit > $1000 must be approved. also prepare a short customer note template in case we need to outbound.

olivia-ops: staging import dry-run output (snippet): ```\n2025-10-02T21:42:05Z INFO -> applying alias mapping 'legacy_flag' -> preserve_legacy\n2025-10-02T21:42:06Z INFO -> converting numeric booleans to true/false for 18 rows\n2025-10-02T21:42:06Z INFO -> post-apply: preserve_legacy=true for 12 rows in preserve cohort\n2025-10-02T21:42:06Z INFO -> estimated invoices impacted if import went live: 0 (mapping fixed)\n```\n
henry-eng: PR merged to staging. will promote to prod after olivia runs the live preflight again. also adding a new checklist item to pricing-rollout: "run vendor-schema-preflight and confirm no unmapped headers" for the next 4 imports.

simeon-fin: huge win. this could have been messy mid-rollout. thanks for the quick loop. raya: can you add the manual signoff step to the rollout doc and tag jules & finance for future imports?

raya-revops: on it. drafting the gate text now and will push to the playbook.

jules-legal: thanks. if any customer asks, use this template: "We identified and corrected a vendor file format mismatch before it affected billing. No action required. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." keeps it factual.

simeon-fin: closing the loop: olivia, post the final preflight/log here after you run it live. will record this as a preventative postmortem note. :white_check_mark:
